title: Compass and Orchard
author: Isandro Coldharbour
blurb: Mara Montrose, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
